## What drives Victoria's electricity demand?

Seven years of half-hourly demand data reveal clear daily and seasonal rhythms, a U-shaped relationship with temperature, and both the value and limits of weather-aware forecasting.

<div class="home-feature-stats">
  <div><strong>122,736</strong><span>observations</span></div>
  <div><strong>2019 to 2025</strong><span>study period</span></div>
  <div><strong>333 MW</strong><span>best average error</span></div>
</div>

[Read the project story](Posts/Economics/Victoria-Electricity-Demand-Forecasting.html){.home-text-link}
:::
